jobs.title: TAMM OS Developer
jobs.description:
About the Company

SWORD Group, being a leader in IT software solutions and services, has 4000 + IT/Digital & Software specialists present over 5 continents to accompany you in the growth of your organization in the digital age. SWORD is present in the MEA region through its offices in UAE, KSA, Cyprus, and Lebanon. As a leader in technological and digital transformation, SWORD Group has since the year 2000 acquired a solid reputation in software solutions and in complex IT & business project management. With SWORD you have the guarantee of strong close and qualified local commitment, the aim of which is to automate your business processes and optimize/maximize the usage of business data.

About TAMM

TAMM is a unified digital ecosystem platform and portal that brings together over 1,000 government and private sector services in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
TAMM Operating System ( TAMM OS
) is a specialized, low-code software development and technology platform developed by the Abu Dhabi government, it functions as a backend ecosystem designed exclusively for government entities.

About the Role

The TAMM OS Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying digital government services and workflows on the TAMM platform.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and deploy digital services using TAMM Workbench and TAMM OS.
Build responsive user interfaces aligned with TAMM Design Language System (DLS) standards.
Integrate TAMM services with enterprise applications, databases, and APIs.
Configure workflows, business processes, forms, and automation components.
Support application lifecycle management, releases, and compliance with government standards.

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
3+ years of software development experience.
Hands-on experience with the TAMM platform is highly preferred.
Strong frontend development skills using React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS.
Backend development experience with Node.js, Express.js, and/or .NET Core.
Experience with REST API integrations and enterprise system integration.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub and CI/CD pipelines.
UAE government digital transformation project experience would be an advantage.

Good to have

Camunda BPM
Docker / Kubernetes
Elasticsearch

________________________________________

Why working at SWORD ?

Enjoy a Hybrid or Remote Work Environment
Being part of a Dynamic and Supportive Environment focused on Employee Wellness
Gain International Exposure and Multicultural Experience
Learn from a Diversified Team of experts across the world
Participate in major projects with industry leaders
Have the possibility to relocate to a regional office within SWORD Group

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Azure Focus) (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Overview
: We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to design, build, and scale and evolution of the Azure AI Platform as a reusable enterprise product. The role builds cloud-native platform capabilities and hybrid-cloud ecosystems from the ground up for a large Financial Enterprise. You will be responsible for creating a robust foundation for our application teams, with a specific focus on operationalizing AI services, maintaining rigorous security standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Infrastructure: Architect and deploy production-ready modular Azure AI platform capabilities. Define platform boundaries, service contracts, tenancy patterns, scaling models and secure integration standards.
Shared AI Capabilities integration Build shared AI service capabilities as platform products by standardizing access to Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Document Intelligence, and other agent/tool orchestration pattern
Standardize application consumption through APIs, SDKs, templates, and reference implementations
Infrastructure as Code:
Define reusable Terraform modules and templatized patterns that provision cloud resources with standard network, identity, security, tagging, observability, built in by default.
Implement policy-as-code and automated validation to ensure every deployment passes checks for naming standards, approved SKUs, network isolation, compliance requirements
Provide self-service provisioning paths through GitHub Actions or platform APIs so teams can request standardized infrastructure pattern
Operate AI orchestration as an enterprise capability with clear service contracts, reusable patterns, release management, platform documentation, onboarding journeys, and continuous improvement based on application demand.
AI Runtime: Engineer production runtimes on AKS and Azure Container Apps for APIs, agents, MCP servers and asynchronous workloads.
API & Connectivity: Manage API lifecycles using Azure APIM and Kong, ensuring secure and performant communication between services.

Technical Requirements:

Cloud: 8+ years experience with Azure Cloud Platform.
IaC: Expertise in Terraform and GitHub Actions, including modular design, automated testing and controlled promotion.
AI Stack: Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry and OpenAI Service.
Networking: Expert knowledge of Network Architecture (VNETs, Peering, Firewalls, Private Links).
APIs: Hands-on experience with Azure API Management or Kong.
Deployment Architecture: Proven ability to create professional Cloud Architectures and provide Solutions Architecture guidance.
Deep hands-on expertise with AKS, Azure Container Apps, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, APIM, identity and private networking.
Experience with Kubernetes, containers, platform APIs, SDK design, observability and SRE practices.
Ability to translate security, risk and compliance requirements into automated platform controls.

Senior Platform Engineer (Azure Focus) in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
